overview: A modern, visually impressive personal portfolio website for an entry-level developer. Features a dark glassmorphism design with violet-cyan gradient accents, animated hero with typing effect, skills showcase, project cards with hover effects, experience timeline, certifications, and a contact form — all fully responsive.
features: Animated hero with typing effect cycling through developer roles
Dark glassmorphism design with violet-cyan gradient accents
Skills showcase with 4 categories: Frontend, Backend, Tools, Soft Skills
Project cards with hover glow effects and tech tags
Vertical experience timeline with fade-in scroll animations
Certifications grid with glass card design
Contact form with success toast notification and social links
Sticky responsive navbar with mobile hamburger menu
Fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop
